Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL3772 (Metabotropic glutamate receptor 1). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
